anomalies.description: A man raises a handgun and aims it forward; the gun is clearly held in a firing posture with arm extended, consistent with an imminent or ongoing shooting.; The man maintains aim with the handgun; in frame f11 (5.5s), a man in a light blue shirt is shown with a fresh bloodstain on his chest and a shocked expression, indicating he has just been shot.; A man in a light blue shirt is struck by a bullet, evidenced by a visible blood splatter on his chest and his shocked expression with mouth open; the gun is pointed at him from the foreground.; After the first victim is hit, the shooter re-aims (f14–f15); simultaneously, a second woman is shown in frame f15 (7.5s) with a bloodstain on her chest and arms raised in shock, indicating she has also been shot.; A woman in a white blouse is struck by a bullet, evidenced by blood splatter on her torso and her recoiling motion with arms raised; the gun remains aimed in her direction.
Blood spatter appears on a cubicle wall, consistent with a gunshot impact; the gun is still held in firing position in the foreground, indicating a recent shot.
A man fires a revolver; a visible muzzle flash and bullet trajectory are captured in frame f15 (15.5s), confirming discharge.
